reset.title: Choose a new password

mfa.title: Enter your sign-in code
mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Hotel Platform.

pin.title: Switch user
pin.notShared: PIN switching works on shared devices a manager has signed in. Sign in with your password here.
pin.sharedHere: This is a shared device. Staff can switch in with their PIN.

setPin.title: Set my PIN
setPin.intro: Use your PIN to switch in quickly on shared front-desk tablets. Avoid easy PINs like 123456.

form.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com

errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. If it keeps happening, quote reference {{requestId}}.

setup.title: Set up {{property}}
setup.intro: Work through the checklist. Bookings open once every required step is done and you go live.

fields.legalNameHint: The registered company name printed on invoices.

rates.ownPrices: Prices in {{currency}} per night, set on this plan.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Load rooms or rates from a spreadsheet. The file is checked first and nothing changes until you confirm.
imports.later: Guests, companies and opening balances arrive with their own screens.
imports.step2: 2. Upload the filled file (CSV or Excel .xlsx)

help.ROOMS: One row per room. A new room type code needs its name on its first row; rooms already in the system are updated. Separate features with a semicolon.
help.RATES: One row per rate plan, room type and date range (from and to included). Prices in naira; leave the price empty to change only restrictions. Dates as 2026-12-01 or 01/12/2026; restrictions as yes or no.

imports.fileType: Use a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
imports.ready: No problems found. Nothing has changed yet.
imports.failed_one: {{count}} problem found. Fix it in the file and upload it again; nothing was imported.
imports.failed_other: {{count}} problems found. Fix them in the file and upload it again; nothing was imported.

roomsLeft.intro: Rooms still to sell per room type and night: rooms − out of order − booked − held + overbooking.
roomsLeft.overbookIntro: Allow selling this many rooms above what you have, per room type and night (default 0). Use it only when you expect cancellations or no-shows.
